about.subtitle: Your local partner in Khiva since day one
about.body: We are a travel agency based in Khiva, Uzbekistan, offering private and shared tours of ancient Khorezm fortresses, Aral Sea adventures, and transfers across Uzbekistan. Our English-speaking drivers pick you up at your hotel for an unforgettable journey through one of Central Asia's richest historical regions.
